traps: Common-English-word ticker: symbol 'FUSION' collides heavily with generic web/API results for the word 'fusion' (nuclear fusion, chemistry, unrelated companies named Fusion-anything) - any pipeline that resolves tickers via plain-text search rather than exchange master data (BSE 543652 / ISIN INE139R01012) will misroute.

Name change mid-history: renamed 'Fusion Micro Finance Limited' -> 'Fusion Finance Limited' in July 2024. A pipeline built before mid-2024, or one scraping an old cached page/PDF, will carry the old name; a pipeline built after will miss pre-2024-07 filings indexed under the old name. Both names resolve to the same ISIN/BSE code.

Lakh/crore scale: all P&L and balance-sheet figures on screener are already in INR crore (stated in the table header 'Figures in Rs. Crores') - a pipeline that assumes lakhs (common for smaller SME-board names) would be off by 100x.

FY2025 loss year distorts every trailing/ratio figure: a -1,225cr standalone net loss in FY Mar2025 (MFI-sector asset-quality crisis) makes TTM-vs-FY-annual-vs-multi-year-average framings of ROE/ROCE/growth diverge wildly (ROE alone ranges 0.68%-6.68% across sources/windows on the SAME day - see roe.disagreements above). A pipeline that TTM-averages across this loss quarter without labelling the window will produce numbers indistinguishable from a healthy quarter's ratios purely from window choice.

Rights issue diluted the share count materially within the trailing 2 years (Equity Capital 101cr -> 162cr, Mar2025 -> Mar2026, ~60% more face-value-10 shares) - any pre-computed EPS/BVPS/ratio cached from before the raise, or a per-share metric computed with a stale share count, will be wrong by a large margin.

Yield trap specific to this manifest entry: 'lending yield 23.4%-23.98%' (cited in manifest hostile_traits) is the interest rate FUSION CHARGES BORROWERS on microfinance loans, not a dividend/bond yield on the stock itself (dividend yield is 0.00% - see dividend.yield above) - a pipeline that free-text-matches 'yield: 23%' against this ticker without checking definition would badly mis-tag it as an extremely high dividend/bond yield.
